messages:
Maya (Finance): Quick alert ACME Health invoice 8247 failed renewal. Gateway decline.
Sam (Payments): Drop the decline payload?
Maya (Finance): gateway -> code=92; reason=refer_to_issuer; cvv=match; avs=partial; 3ds=challenge_required
Eli (Support): They updated card and tried retry in UI, same result. Customer asked for alternative payment.
Sam (Payments): 92 means issuer referral. Not automatable. Also 3DS not completed mobile flows often fail.
payments-bot: webhook event payment_failed for intent=8247 at 2026-03-15T14:02:13Z
Nora (Accounting): Invoice total $18,200. We can accept wire (account ok for <=$50k).
Maya (Finance): Prefer wire to avoid credits. Pause auto-retries while they initiate wire.
Sam (Payments): Also offer re-adding card via desktop to complete 3DS; we attempt one immediate charge if they do.
Eli (Support): Messaging customer: "Two options: (1) re-add card on desktop to finish 3DS and we'll try once, (2) reply 'WIRE' and we'll send wire instructions. We'll pause retries for 48h."
payments-bot: followup reminder scheduled for invoice 8247 in 48h
Eli (Support): Customer replied 'WIRE'. Forwarding to finance.
Nora (Accounting): Sent wire details and asked for bank confirmation. Subject: "Redwood Inference - Wire instructions for invoice 8247"
Sam (Payments): When proof arrives I'll mark paid and cancel gateway retries. Add internal note to prevent auto-refund.
Maya (Finance): Action: add KB about desktop 3DS and a triage step for decline_code=92. Closing loop after payment clears.
